name: partly-known-actor-critic
description: One page on policy gradients that mentions REINFORCE, baselines and actor-critic in passing: those are partly known steps, value functions are new. Re-plan after a page on the Q-function (which implies value functions).

blocks.text: REINFORCE weights each log-probability by the return; subtracting a baseline reduces variance. Actor-critic methods learn that baseline.
Q(s, a) is the expected discounted reward after taking action a in state s and then following the policy.
